text:
sylvia: quick thread for HelixRetail POC. They want streaming via SDK (node + python), function/tool-calls to query their product catalog, and strict structured JSON (for downstream analytics). Also asked about SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS (cloud or on-prem), and a monthly ballpark for ~350 sustained QPS. Any blocking concerns? :mag_right:

omar: doable but a few notes: 1) 350 sustained with streaming+external tool latency -> recommend Dedicated/reserved to meet p99 SLOs. 2) Tool-call variability (catalog DB) can add tail latency; design async tool-call pattern and return progressive partials. 3) SAML/KMS are process items (security/legal).

kevin: for deterministic JSON we recommend function-calling with an output schema and server-side validation. We usually send a json-schema and a small validator lib. Example schema snippet we can start with:
```json
{ "type":"object", "properties": { "request_id": {"type":"string"}, "actions": {"type":"array", "items": {"type":"object"}}, "meta": {"type":"object"} }, "required":["request_id"] }
```

kevin: Node streaming quickstart for them to kick off:
```js
const {StreamClient} = require('@redwood/sdk')
const c = new StreamClient(process.env.RW_TOKEN)
c.stream({model:'redwood-chat-1'}).on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk))
```

liz: security/Risk: SOC2 is covered. On-prem KMS requires legal addendum + an infra runbook (we'll need network diagrams). If they take cloud KMS we can do expedited onboarding. SAML: ask for IdP metadata (entityID, x509 cert, ACS url). Turnaround for enabling SAML in Private: ~3 business days after receiving metadata.

omar: pricing ballpark: if median output ~80 tokens and 350 QPS steady, Dedicated recommended. Rough committed cost 30-55k/mo before negotiable discounts depending on term and model family. Hosted could work for a short pilot but will cost more and has softer latency guarantees.

kevin: adapter notes: I'll drop a small Node adapter that implements tool-call hooks and a fallback path after a 1.8s tool timeout. It will emit a partial placeholder to keep stream alive and patch final payload when tool completes. Also include backpressure controls (maxInflightRequests=64, batchWindow=25ms).

kevin: adapter snippet (node):
```js
client.on('tool_call', async (call) => {
  const result = await Promise.race([callEHR(call.payload), timeout(1800)])
  if (!result) return {action:'noop', payload:{}}
  return {action:'catalog_hits', payload: result}
})
```

liz: fallback plans if KMS/SAML slip: 1) Hosted with cloud-KMS + ephemeral creds for POC (ephemeral creds via STS). 2) Use a sanitized/stubbed catalog dataset for initial validation of streaming + schema. 3) Defer SAML to post-POC. All acceptable to security as long as audit logs and encryption in transit at rest are documented.

omar: ephemeral creds example (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.ai/sts -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"ttl":600}'
```

sylvia: can someone produce a 1-pager runbook (onboarding steps, customer artifacts needed, success criteria) so I can send to the buyer today? Also include a simple capacity calc template.

kevin: i'll assemble the runbook skeleton + node/python examples. will add a note about grading model quantization fallback for cost spikes.

liz: i'll add security checklist (IdP metadata fields, KMS auth examples, logs/residency note). if on-prem KMS, flag legal early.

omar: i'll prepare the pricing estimate and a capacity sizing appendix — include recommended Dedicated size and fallback routing to quantized variants.

ci-bot: created doc "helix-poc-runbook-v1" in sales/gdrive and shared with @sylvia @omar @kevin @liz :page_facing_up:

sylvia: awesome. action items: kevin - runbook & adapters (today), liz - security checklist & legal flag (EOD), omar - pricing & capacity calc (EOD). i'll schedule kickoff and ping the buyer. thanks! :rocket:
